description: rabpro is a Python River and Basin Profiler distributed by the VeinsOfTheEarth project. Given a location, it delineates a watershed, extracts a main-channel elevation profile and computes catchment statistics. It uses hydrographic data for basin delineation and provides a wrapper around Google Earth Engine for spatial statistics and time-varying forcing. These outputs can prepare catchment geometry and environmental inputs for reservoir, flood or water-supply models. The software supports global locations, but resolution and temporal coverage follow the selected datasets. Source code and examples are public on GitHub under BSD-3-Clause. A limitation is that cloud statistics depend on Earth Engine access and the availability and terms of its data sources; basin delineation is also constrained by source hydrography. The catalogue records data-hydrosheds-hydrorivers-hydrobasins and data-merit-hydro-global-hydrography-90m describe its named inputs. This review read documentation only and did not sign in to Earth Engine, download rasters or execute a delineation. The code is available free of charge under its stated licence.
